spell.new-old-spells-plus.confusion.desc:
{Advanced Confusion}

Target enemy unit cannot retaliate.

{Basic Confusion}

Target enemy unit cannot retaliate once.

{Expert Confusion}

All enemy units cannot retaliate.

{Confusion}

Target enemy unit cannot retaliate once.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.confusion.name: Confusion
spell.new-old-spells-plus.deepFreeze.des:
{Advanced Deep Freeze}

Freezes target which takes 67% more physical damage until it gets turn.

{Basic Deep Freeze}

Freezes target which takes 33% more physical damage until it gets turn.

{Expert Deep Freeze}

Freezes target which takes 100% more physical damage until it gets turn.

{Deep Freeze}

Freezes target which takes 33% more physical damage until it gets turn.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.dragonStrength:
{Advanced Dragon Strength}

Increases health and damage of a friendly unit by 75%. Does not affect Dragons.

{Basic Dragon Strength}

Increases health and damage of a friendly unit by 50%. Does not affect Dragons.

{Expert Dragon Strength}

Doubles health and damage of a friendly unit. Does not affect Dragons.

{Dragon Strength}

Increases health and damage of a friendly unit by 50%. Does not affect Dragons.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.levitation.des:
{Advanced Levitation}

Makes the selected unit able to fly.

{Basic Levitation}

Makes the selected unit able to fly until it attacks.

{Expert Levitation}

Makes all friendly units able to fly.

{Levitation}

Makes the selected unit able to fly until it attacks.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.oh3Fear.descri:
{Basic Fear}

Strikes an enemy unit with such fear, that it becomes unable to attack and nearly unable to move (-25% speed).

{Fear}

Strikes an enemy unit with such fear, that it becomes unable to attack and nearly unable to move (-25% speed).
spell.new-old-spells-plus.oh3Fear.name: Fear
spell.new-old-spells-plus.puppetMaster.d:
{Advanced Puppet Master}

Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control until the unit takes damage. The affected unit is slightly slowed down.

{Basic Puppet Master}

Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control until the unit takes damage. The affected unit is slowed down.

{Expert Puppet Master}

Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control until the unit takes damage.

{Puppet Master}

Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control until the unit takes damage. The affected unit is slowed down.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.vampirism.desc:
{Advanced Vampirism}

Friendly unit becomes undead and heals itself for 35% of damage dealt to enemy.

{Basic Vampirism}

Friendly unit becomes undead and heals itself for 20% of damage dealt to enemy.

{Expert Vampirism}

Friendly unit becomes undead and heals itself for 50% of damage dealt to enemy.

{Vampirism}

Friendly unit becomes undead and heals itself for 20% of damage dealt to enemy.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.vampirism.name: Vampirism
spell.new-old-spells-plus.vigour.descrip:
{Advanced Vigour}

Gives the selected unit ability to strike twice in melee.

{Basic Vigour}

The selected unit will strike twice next time it attacks in melee.

{Expert Vigour}

Gives all friendly units ability to strike twice in melee.

{Vigour}

The selected unit will strike twice next time it attacks in melee.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.vigour.name: Vigour
spell.new-old-spells-plus.waspSwarm.desc:
{Advanced Wasp Swarm}

Does little damage to target and reduces its speed for this turn.

{Basic Wasp Swarm}

Does little damage to target and reduces its speed for this turn.

{Expert Wasp Swarm}

Does little damage to target and reduces its speed for this turn.

{Wasp Swarm}

Does little damage to target and reduces its speed for this turn.
spell.new-old-spells-plus.waspSwarm.name: Wasp Swarm
